title: It’s a good electric kettle for the price but the base sticks on when you lift the pot to pour!
text: It’s a good electric kettle for the price but the base sticks on when you lift the pot to pour!. I like this electric kettle.  I mainly use the kettle to make tea every morning and several times throughout the day.  I really like that the water boils quickly but I don’t like when you lift up the pot to pour the water and the base of the heat source continues to stick on the bottom of the pot instead of naturally releasing.  Twice when this has happened I’ve instinctively shook the kettle to try to get the base to fall off and have splashed boiling water on my hand.  The base sticks on almost all of the time now and the kettle is only about two months old.
